about_the_game:
The exiles have fled their world, seeking an audience with their creator to set right ancient wrongs.  They are joined by heroes each seeking salvation of their own.

  • EXPANSIVE, GROWING STORY:
    Over 200,000 words of narrative to explore and 15 unique characters.  Find your friends and reach hope.

  • TURN-BASED STRATEGIC COMBAT:
    Fight in turn based strategy combat across 50 handcrafted battles.  Use cards, passives, and tactics to win.  Learn what characters synergize well with each other.  Match characters and cards together to get massive results.

  • EXPANSIVE INVENTORY SYSTEM: 
    Hundreds of unique items to be discovered and unlocked.  Wisely pick your items to progress through the story.  Upgrade items for more power.  Unlock items and tokens to equip even stronger items.

  • UNIQUE ADVENTURE MODE: 
    Adventure mode is a separate roguelike story-light version of the game. It contains hundreds of unique encounters, along with special items and cards that are only found in this mode. Level up very fast and experiment with various builds. Be careful, as a single lost fight sends you back to the start. Each victory or defeat permanently unlocks new characters and items.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains legal and sensible alcohol consumption.  Contains fantasy violence and depictions of heroes battling for a better world.  Contains a lot of heroic swearing and cursing.
